case_number: 2025 INSC 1; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 8659 of 2023)
summary: Validity of complaint under Section 138 NI Act; complainant must be payee or holder in due course; power of attorney holder with personal knowledge may file complaint; High Court erred in quashing proceedings solely on alleged lack of personal knowledge; precedent from TRL Krosaki, Shankar Finance, and others affirmed; summoning order reinstated.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.482, s.200, s.190
Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.420, s.467, s.468, s.471
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment quashing complaint set aside; complaint proceedings under Section 138 NI Act restored.
